title: Choose the portfolio composition
question: The roll assigned Card of the book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Visual world stays the racing form; this pick is how your totals, your horses, and deposit or withdraw sit together.

options.label: Card of the book
options.lineage: The racing card, with your book as the call
options.thesis: Your totals take the call; the program strip is only the horses you already hold.
options.viewport: Masthead. The fold is the landing grid: the giant CALL is YOUR BOOK (PnL in purse green, capital at risk, SYNTHETIC). The right FACTS column is the selected horse's cashier slip — amount, chips, Deposit stamp, outlined WITHDRAW for backers. The bottom PROGRAM STRIP is your horses with silks and BACKED or MINE tags; MINE rows have no withdraw. Selecting a horse updates the slip only; the call stays the book.
options.risk: A visitor may read the giant call as a public horse and try to bet the field.

raised.raise: The slip prints estimated shares before the stamp, so deposit and redeem preview before the wallet.
Backed and Mine sit as two coasts on the program strip, never mixed without a mark.

options.label: Book tote
options.lineage: Overnight tote plus Hot Sheet, filtered to your holdings
options.thesis: The book is a tote of your horses; money moves on the overlay, not the row.
options.viewport: Masthead, then a result line of book PnL and capital at risk. Conditions chips: BACKED / MINE / ALL. Full-bleed tote of your horses. Opening a BACKED row slides a 40% Hot Sheet: shares, PnL, amount, Deposit stamp, WITHDRAW. Opening a MINE row is watch-only vault PnL — no redeem.
options.risk: Repeats /program so the book may not feel like an account.

options.label: Settling window
options.lineage: Entry papers / clerk window, used to settle
options.thesis: The page is the teller: totals on the ticket, then you stamp or redeem the selected horse.
options.viewport: Masthead. One boxed SETTLE sheet fills the rest. Top: YOUR BOOK, PnL, capital at risk. A slim numbered list of holdings down the left (BACKED / MINE). The remaining field is the slip for the selected horse — shares, PnL, amount underline, Deposit stamp, WITHDRAW as a scratched-style outline. No overlay.
options.risk: A short book looks empty; a long book turns the list into a cramped rail.
